execution.ref: VALIDATOR-09 slice 2 (phase 3), branch claude/validator-09-phase3-variant, decision VALIDATOR-09-PHASE3-VARIANT-01. Targeted phase-3, door, controller and variant tests passed; the results are recorded in the PR.
execution.description: Graphite phase 3 resolves a development score variant before spend, pins it in the brief and the profile, records its result beside the frozen rule's on every result, refuses a resume under another variant, and every miner door refuses it by name.

expected: The variant's rule could replace the frozen rule, and its scoring inputs would follow from the variant document.
observed: Replacing the frozen rule would need a variant-side comparison margin, which no authority sets, so the variant's result sits beside the base rule's as an order and is never promotable. member_legs also needs a value contract that neither registry names (five are committed), so the shipped entry is HUMAN_INPUT and refuses before spend.
keep: Add a development-only rule beside the governing rule, never in its place, until its comparison is owned.
Extend the one data-only name check every miner door already uses, rather than adding a check per door.
change: A variant document should pin every input its score depends on, including the value contract, so a runner never has to choose one.
protocol_elements: a development scoring variant is resolved before spend, pinned in the session's brief and profile, labelled on every result, and refused on every miner door by name
